header.deleteMessage: Its statistics and timeline are removed for good. The jobs, exclusions and everything else the run observed stay as they are.
header.startedToast: Run started. Everything the agent does from now on is counted.
header.startHint: Start a run before handing the agent a task and stop it when the task is done; everything in between is counted.

empty.title: No run in progress
empty.body: Start a run before handing the agent a task and stop it when the task is done. Everything the agent does in between is counted here: searches per site, jobs queued, forms filled, challenges hit, failures and more.
empty.history: Past runs can be picked from the list above.

tips.eventsPerHour: Recorded observations divided by hours the run has been going; a rough measure of how busy the agent was.

tips.results: Results after duplicates across sites were removed; the per-source table counts what each site returned on its own.
tips.blocked: Searches where a site answered with a verification challenge instead of listings.

sources.empty: No source has been touched in this run yet.

tips.results: Rows the site returned, before duplicates across sites were removed.
tips.blocked: Searches the site answered with a verification challenge.
tips.warned: Searches where the site came back with a warning: nothing matched, an unrecognised layout, or a board that could not be fetched.
tips.read: Postings read in full with get_job_details.
tips.queued: Jobs from this site the agent put on the board.
tips.filled: Application forms filled, in full or in part, plus jobs marked filled by hand.
tips.submitted: Jobs from this site you marked Submitted.
tips.failed: Jobs from this site that moved to Failed.
tips.excluded: Postings from this site added to the exclusion list.

tips.queueExisting: queue_job calls for a posting that was already on the board.
tips.queueExcluded: queue_job calls refused because the posting is on the exclusion list.
tips.matchScore: The scores the agent gave the jobs it queued, out of 100.

tips.inspected: inspect_application calls that opened a form.
tips.attempts: Every fill_application and edit_application call, whatever it returned.
tips.permissionDenied: Attempts stopped because the agent lacked a permission you had not granted.
tips.noSession: Attempts made without an application form open; the agent has to inspect first.

tips.paused: Times a site showed a verification challenge while a form was being opened, pausing the job until you cleared it.

tools.empty: No tool calls in this run yet.

tips.calls: Every call the agent made to an Applyer tool through MCP.
tips.errors: Calls that answered with an error, including refused ones.

timeline.empty: Nothing recorded in this run yet.

events.job_details_blocked: A posting on {{source}} answered with a challenge
events.job_details_not_found: A posting on {{source}} could not be read
events.job_queue_excluded: Refused to queue an excluded posting from {{source}}
events.form_inspected_failed: Could not inspect the form for {{job}}
events.captcha_paused_search: A search on {{source}} paused on a verification challenge
events.captcha_resolved_search: The search on {{source}} resumed after the challenge
